abstract: Maintains heat exchanger maintenance validation files and reserved district baseline thermal loads
system_message:
You are the Plant facilities manager (PFM), responsible for maintaining heat exchanger maintenance validation files and tracking reserved district baseline thermal loads.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: excluding peak cold-weather emergency reserves·Maintains heat exchanger maintenance validation files and reserved district baseline thermal loads（CHEM）
information_points.content:
PFM-CHEM-M3L：For the Deep sedimentary doublet circulation scheme accounting for loads excluding peak cold-weather emergency reserves, heat exchanger fouling margin verification is confirmed (true) and the reserved baseline thermal load is 22 MWth.
PFM-CHEM-PJS：For the Fault-assisted hydrothermal extraction scheme assessed excluding peak cold-weather emergency reserves, heat exchanger fouling margin verification is not confirmed (false) and the reserved baseline thermal load is 22 MWth.
PFM-CHEM-LOL：For the Multi-lateral closed-loop conduction scheme evaluated excluding peak cold-weather emergency reserves, heat exchanger fouling margin verification is confirmed (true) and the reserved baseline thermal load is 12 MWth.

information_points.title: including peak cold-weather emergency reserves·Maintains heat exchanger maintenance validation files and reserved district baseline thermal loads（PLNT）
information_points.content:
PFM-PLNT-ZT0：For the Multi-lateral closed-loop conduction scheme evaluated including peak cold-weather emergency reserves, heat exchanger fouling margin verification is confirmed (true) with a reserved baseline thermal load of 12 MWth.
PFM-PLNT-4QE：For the Fault-assisted hydrothermal extraction scheme under the basis including peak cold-weather emergency reserves, heat exchanger fouling margin verification is not confirmed (false) and the reserved baseline thermal load stands at 22 MWth.
PFM-PLNT-H6E：For the Deep sedimentary doublet circulation scheme evaluated including peak cold-weather emergency reserves, heat exchanger fouling margin verification is confirmed (true) and the reserved baseline thermal load is 12 MWth.
